{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Confirm no sentinel values or missing data in biomarker_final
assert df['biomarker_final'].isin([-999.0]).sum() == 0, "Sentinel value -999.0 found in biomarker_final"
assert df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum() == 0, "Missing values in biomarker_final"

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_final"}
